claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Navitas 的 10-Q、10-K 或財報稿寫出 GaN 功率元件不再出貨給 AI 基礎設施相關應用，或 GlobalFoundries 的 GaN 代工中止且沒有替代產線。核查頻率：每季（Navitas 10-Q／10-K 與財報稿）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 的 claim 降信心，重讀 Power GaN 層（tech:power_gan）。
claims.statement: Navitas Semiconductor's third-quarter 2026 results press release (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1, filed 2026-11-03) says the company announced first shipments of its latest Gen 5 GaNFast devices, manufactured in the United States through GlobalFoundries, to accelerate AI infrastructure deployments, and describes Navitas as pioneering GaN, high-voltage and ultra-high-voltage SiC, and IVR technologies. It does not name any AI data-center customer, a GaN shipment volume or a GaN revenue amount.
